affectedPublicSurfaces: demo.app-juli.com -- the NOTIFICATION CENTRE, one of the seven S-FR-1 surfaces, reached from the app shell (`apps/demo/src/components/demo-shell.tsx`). Today `apps/demo` has NO toast, banner, badge or unread concept anywhere (`ux-surface.md` D), so the unread indicator lands in the shell and therefore appears on EVERY route -- `/`, `/decisions`, `/decisions/**`, `/analytics`, `/settings`. That blast radius is why all shell-bearing routes are probed below.

The act-records calls from the browser to `api.app-juli.com` -- #1713's tenant-scoped list endpoint over #1712's `run_act_records` (kind `reminder | digest | automated_act | completion | exception`; what / when / why / otherwise / undo hint; state `pending | delivered | read | failed`; channel `in_app`) plus its read-state update. Nothing reads it today; this slice is its only consumer.

The deep links out of a record into an EXISTING surface -- a decision (`/decisions/recommendations/[recommendationId]`), a run (`/decisions/in-progress/[executionId]`) or a record's own row. v1 adds no surface beyond the seven plus #1790's waived deadline list, so a record naming a surface that does not exist renders WITHOUT an activatable control rather than inventing one.
`packages/contracts/src/seller-copy.ts` -- the shared banned-pattern guard over every row's what / when / why, the empty state and the unread count's label.

Explicitly NOT touched, and named here because three latent pieces make it tempting: `backend/.../services/alerts/`'s FCM stub and its real Zalo OA adapter (both with zero callers) and iOS's push permission with no token upload. All out of v1 by spec 8.3 decision 4 -- in-app is the ONLY v1 channel.

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Pre-merge: vitest (jsdom) component tests run from the worktree root through the workspace filter, so the suite resolves THIS worktree's `apps/demo` and `packages/contracts` and not a stale sibling checkout. Post-deploy: the candidate demo is reached only through the restricted test listener/hostname -- zero public traffic, `candidatePublicTrafficPercent` 0, stable serving 100% -- and the walk is done in a real browser so a missing JS chunk shows up as a broken surface rather than as a green status code.
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: apiSideEffectsInScope is TRUE: opening a record on the candidate POSTs a read-state update for the Synthetic shop's own record. workersDisabledOnCandidate stays TRUE -- the records are written by #1713 and merely READ here; no beat task or worker is needed, and none may be started to make the centre look populated.

journeys.name: notification-centre-renders-real-records-with-honest-read-state
assertions: pre-merge: captured act records of EACH of the five kinds each render the record's OWN what, when and why, ordered newest first, with an unread count equal to the number of records not in state `read`; mutating a record's state CHANGES the count (src/__tests__/notification-centre.test.tsx::renders_every_kind_from_its_record_with_an_unread_count)

pre-merge: opening an unread record sends EXACTLY ONE read request and the count drops; opening it a SECOND time sends NO further request -- idempotent at the client (src/__tests__/notification-centre.test.tsx::opening_marks_read_once_and_is_idempotent_at_the_client)

pre-merge: a record whose payload names a surface navigates to THAT EXISTING surface; a record naming none renders with NO activatable control -- asserted on the rendered tree, so a dead link cannot ship (src/__tests__/notification-centre.test.tsx::deep_links_reach_existing_surfaces_and_never_dead_ends)

pre-merge: an EMPTY list renders a calm empty state and NO record-shaped content appears -- asserted by scanning the tree, so a fixture fallback cannot be reintroduced. A fabricated record is exactly the "the demo looked healthy" defect #1320 exists to prevent (src/__tests__/notification-centre.test.tsx::an_empty_list_renders_empty_not_fabricated)

pre-merge: EVERY seller-facing string this surface renders is collected from the RENDERED tree (not from a hand-listed constant array) and checked against `SELLER_COPY_BANNED_PATTERNS` imported from `packages/contracts/src/seller-copy.ts` -- the shared `packages/contracts/seller-copy-banned-patterns.json` source, never a local copy of the list -- and no run id, tool name or stop-reason identifier is rendered (src/__tests__/notification-centre.test.tsx::seller_strings_pass_the_banned_pattern_guard)

Hand-authored event or envelope JSON is NOT an acceptable input (ADR-084 d.2); a shape the capture tool cannot yet produce is a gap in the tool, not a licence to type one out -- here specifically captured payloads from #1713's REAL tenant-scoped list endpoint

htmlRoutes: the notification centre's own mounted view (shell panel or existing route)
staticAssetChecks.notes: The centre must be in the BUILT bundle -- the issue's own release-evidence line -- and because the unread indicator lives in the shell, EVERY shell-bearing route is probed: a chunk that 404s here breaks the whole app, not one screen. Route shapes verified against `apps/demo/src/app/` in this tree on 2026-09-08: the only page.tsx files under /decisions are `decisions/page.tsx`, `decisions/recommendations/[recommendationId]/page.tsx` and `decisions/in-progress/[executionId]/page.tsx`. There is NO `/decisions/in-progress` and NO `/decisions/recommendations` index route -- the In-Progress view is the SAME HTML document at /decisions under the `?tab=in-progress` query param (`recommendations-view.tsx` reads `searchParams.get("tab")`). Earlier plans (#1314, #1318) named those two as routes; probing them as HTML routes would 404 and the probe must not be written that way.

migrationCompatibility.notes: NO SCHEMA CHANGE. `run_act_records` is #1712's table and the tenant-scoped list endpoint with its read-state semantics is #1713's; both are hard dependencies. This slice's whole diff is under `apps/demo/**` and `packages/contracts/src/**`; it opens no migration file, and the migration numbers for the backend slices it depends on are RESERVED BY META and never read from head. If a test cannot pass without a column or an endpoint, the dependency is unmet and the answer is to stop and report, not to write a migration or a second route. Stable and candidate are compatible because the previous bundle simply does not render the new surface, and the rows and routes it reads are unchanged by this slice.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge; discard the candidate and keep the retained previous bundle serving 100%. The seller receives nothing today, so the pre-cutover state is the current state.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: Redeploy the retained previous demo bundle. Additive on the client: the records remain READABLE THROUGH THE ENDPOINT and no read state is lost, because read state lives on the server. Assert on the rolled-back bundle that the shell renders without a stranded bell or an unread badge wired to nothing.
rollbackAssertion.notes: The PREVIOUS demo bundle is RETAINED and stays serving 100% of public traffic until the candidate passes; rollback is redeploying that retained bundle. Rollback is NOT automatic for this slice: the failure modes here are visual and structural (a surface that renders blank, a chunk that 404s), which a health probe does not catch, so a human reads the candidate journey and decides. No schema step is involved in either direction.

doNotInfer: Do NOT add a surface. v1's seller surfaces are the seven S-FR-1 names -- card, plan review, confirmation sheet, run view, completion message + exception list, notification centre, deadline list -- plus the single deadline view added by the owner waiver of 2026-09-05 (#1790, and ONLY #1790). A slice that believes it needs an eighth surface, a new tab, a new modal shell or a new route is a signal the routing or the design is wrong: STOP AND REPORT, do not build it.

Do NOT hand-author event or envelope JSON, anywhere, for any reason. ADR-084 d.2 forbids it: a second hand-maintained source drifts from the first while both suites stay green -- the defect class behind six W3 post-merge fixes. Test inputs are the captured contract payloads and the tool-captured golden scenarios (#1311). ADR-094 d.5 relaxes this ONLY for the existing client replay in `mock-data.ts`, which this slice neither extends nor imitates.

Do NOT write English seller-facing copy. Vietnamese only, second person ("ban"), per S-NFR-4 and S-NFR-12; there is no EN toggle in v1 (`ux-surface.md` F.12 option (a)). An English label, an English empty state, an English error, or an English tooltip is a defect even when it never ships to a Vietnamese seller in the demo walk.

Do NOT let an internal identifier reach seller-facing text. No `workflow_key`, tool name, playbook key, predicate or guard name, stop-reason identifier, `subject_ref`, run id, order id, SKU id or warehouse id in any rendered string (ADR-084 d.5, S-NFR-4). The banned-pattern guard is the floor, not the ceiling: an identifier the regex list happens not to match is still a defect.

Do NOT read the workflow's identity from anything but the seller-facing envelope. Grouping, gating and labelling derive from `recommendation.workflow_name` and the `is_executable` discriminator that `packages/contracts/src/decisions.ts` already carries; `workflow_key` is absent from that envelope by ADR-084 d.3 and must NOT be reintroduced, inferred, reverse-engineered from a title, or smuggled in through a URL segment. If a v1 workflow cannot be distinguished without leaking the taxonomy, STOP AND REPORT (#1793).

Do NOT render a value outside a numeric field's validated range, and do NOT invent the range. Bounds come from the contract descriptor (`packages/contracts/src/review.ts`), never from a component literal; CE-FR-4's stock goal is `0 <= goal < sellable` and RI-NFR-3 forbids a write below the committed quantity. A control that can express an out-of-range value -- an unclamped slider, a free-text number, a spinner without bounds -- is the defect, whether or not a validator catches it afterwards (#1783).

Do NOT change a backend route, response model, payload producer or database row from this slice. Domain is ui-ux, one domain per issue; the producers are named in the issue's Blocked-by list. Do NOT open `apps/dashboard/`, `ios/`, `backend/src/juli_backend/ai/`, `backend/src/juli_backend/workers/` or the TikTok corpora catalogs (ADR-051) -- this epic's doNotLoad list.

Do NOT prove a contract with a `**kwargs` double or a hand-rolled stub of a contract type. Bind every test collaborator to the REAL exported type and the REAL module; a double proves routing, never that the real payload would render. Consumer-without-producer is the failure this wave exists to prevent.

Do NOT synthesise a record. The centre does not manufacture a reminder from a deadline it noticed, does not summarise records into a digest of its own, and does not render a placeholder when the list is empty.
Do NOT wire FCM, Zalo or email, and do NOT add a device-token upload. In-app is the ONLY v1 channel (spec 8.3 decision 4). The `services/alerts/` adapters stay callerless.
Do NOT add a toast or any interrupt over the current screen. The centre is a surface the seller opens, not something that seizes the screen.
Do NOT build the deadline list here -- it is #1790, its own surface, reading different feeds.
Do NOT compute read state client-side or optimistically. One open, one request, one server-owned state.
